headline: Approved minutes, green covers up to $8K, and tennis windscreen up to $3.1K while reviewing project updates.
summary: The commission approved the May 12, 2026 minutes and heard financial and project updates, including tennis court resurfacing completion and fencing near green #15. Members approved funding for green covers and a tennis court windscreen, and discussed ongoing capital project planning and facility repairs.
decisions: Approved purchase of green covers for winter protection not to exceed $8,000.
Approved windscreen for the tennis courts not to exceed $3,100.
transcript:
# MEETING MINUTES

Board: Golf and Tennis Commission
Date: June 9,2026
Location: Beverly Golf & Tennis
Members Present: Chair William Lowd, Vice-Chair Martin Lawler,
Arthur Athanas, Chad Crandall, Kevin Ascolillo, Paul Sciamanna
Guests: Chris Carter, Sean Ciancarellli, Steve Murphy, Mike LaPierre
Recorder: Donna Musumeci

## Minutes:

Arthur Athanas: Motion to approve the minutes of May 12, 2026.
Kevin Ascolillo seconded.  The motion carries (6-0).

## Financial Update:
Martin advised enough funding to carry us to end FY26. Tennis courts resurfacing and prep area were completed this month, completed the fencing next to green #15 and the street.

Bill met with Bryant Ayles while forming the 2027 budget, to consider a large capital project.
Commission would like Bryant to come to an upcoming meeting to get into the process.

## Project Updates:
Sean is continuing to look at the Calvert between 8th green and 9th tee, grant not approved.
Expecting to have painted, the Veranda cement surface, repair dishwasher on 2nd floor,
Look into needed repair to the fan on the roof (quote needed), quotes for repair of
several cart paths needing filling of holes.
Chris looking into replacing some green covers for winter protection (Quotes) App'd NTE $8K.
Mike L to look into windscreen for the Tennis courts (Quotes) Approved NTE $3.1K.
Rennick Clock to be hooked up to the circuits in cart barn (need conduit)
Flower boxes will be used to protect railings until they can be replaced.
Report of fallen branches on 3rd and 4th holes.

Jim Tognazzi and crew, have completed 35 projects for the facility.

Hole #18 Fairway
Still open issue.

## GFMI Update
Total starts for May: 7241, fair weather. Members up a little over last year, expect juniors June.
All paid up with the City, all positive moving forward.
Tennis: All enrollments done, new sprinklers all working.

Martin Lawler:  Motion to adjourn,, Arthur Athanas  Seconded, Motion passes 6-0
